description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Kefka (Poison)], & MAG +500 to user.
TP Max: AOE Poison/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Mode
description.text: Poison abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times and don't consume ability uses, Poison abilities ignore 20% of the target's DEF and RES, keeps track of the number of Poison abilities used, removes [Tactical Awoken Mode] after using 8 Poison abilities, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
One single piercing attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user.
Grants [Poison Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Poison Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)] to user, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if the user has Attach Poison 0-1/2
WS Blue: Grants [Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] to user
WS Gold: Grants [Poison Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Poison Quick Cast (Tactical)] to user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Poison Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Poison attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Poison Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)
Attach Poison 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Poison Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Poison abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Poison Quick Cast (Tactical)
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Poison while in Tactical Awoken Mode
